symptom: mxcli new cannot select a specific native Studio Pro installation when multiple builds or betas share a release number
cause: new expands the requested version through the CDN before local resolution and has no explicit toolchain override; a numeric release search cannot identify the caller's chosen installation
insight: Resolve an explicit toolchain before normalizing a version through a remote release list, and pass the resolved pair through creation and the first build. Resolve raw paths before lexical cleaning or directory joins, derive companion executables from the symlink target, and verify staged models before publishing them so rejection preserves the destination and permits a corrected retry. A fake executable reached through the real CLI proves the flag is wired; helper-only tests cannot establish that the command bypasses CDN resolution.
